# Geodata

```{r}

nepal_admin <- read_xlsx("./data/npl_admin_boundaries.xlsx", 
                         sheet = 7) |> 
  select(adm3_name, adm3_pcode, adm2_name, adm2_pcode, adm1_name, adm1_pcode)

affected_municipalities_wards <- read_xls("./data/Affected_wardsv2.xls") |> 
  janitor::clean_names() |> 
  select(adm1_pcode, 
         district = adm2_en, 
         adm2_pcode,
         municipality = adm3_en, 
         adm3_pcode, 
         ward = new_ward_n) |> 
  left_join(
    nepal_admin |> 
      distinct(adm1_name, adm1_pcode), 
    by = "adm1_pcode"
  ) |> 
  rename(province = adm1_name) |> 
  relocate(province, .before = adm1_pcode) |> 
  distinct(adm3_pcode, ward)

wards <- st_read("./data/shapefiles/npl_admn_ad4_py_s1_ocha_hp_wards.shp")

affected_wards <- read_xls("./data/Affected_wardsV2.xls") |> 
  janitor::clean_names()

adm3 <- st_read("./data/shapefiles/npl_admin_boundaries.shp/npl_admin3.shp")

adm2 <- st_read("./data/shapefiles/npl_admin_boundaries.shp/npl_admin2.shp")

river <- st_read("./data/shapefiles/aoi_affd_aff_py_s3_govn_pp_AOI500mBuffer.shp") 

```

```{r}
municipal_damage_losses <- read_csv("./data/municipal_damage_loss.csv")

municipal_damage_losses |> glimpse()
```

```{r}
municipal_long <- municipal_damage_losses |> 
  mutate(affected_hectares_agriculture = paddy_affected_hectares + vegetables_affected_hectares, 
         total_baseline_hectares = paddy_baseline_hectares + vegetables_baseline_hectares, 
         pc_affected_hectares = affected_hectares_agriculture / total_baseline_hectares, 
         pc_affected_buildings = affected_buildings / estimated_buildings_in_damaged_corridor, 
         pc_impacted_households = impacted_households / households_in_affected_wards_census_2021) |> 
  select(adm2_pcode, adm3_pcode, impacted_households, 
         pc_impacted_households, 
         impacted_population = impacted_population_total,
         affected_buildings, pc_affected_buildings,
         affected_hectares_agriculture, pc_affected_hectares) |> 
  pivot_longer(cols = impacted_households:pc_affected_hectares, 
               names_to = "variable", 
               values_to = "value") 


  filter(!str_detect(variable, "pc_")) |> 
  count(variable)

```

## Plotting function

```{r}
municipal_damage_losses |> 
  filter(municipality == "Likhu")
```



```{r}
magnitude_plot <- function(tbl, filter_value) {
  
  tbl |> 
    filter(variable == filter_value) |> 
    mutate(variable = str_replace_all(variable, "_", " "),
           variable = str_to_title(variable)) |> 
    right_join(adm3, 
              by = c("adm2_pcode", "adm3_pcode")) |>
    mutate(adm3_name_label = ifelse(!is.na(value), adm3_name, ""),
           label = ifelse(!is.na(value),
                          as.character(format(round(value, 1), big.mark = ",")), 
                          "")) |>
    replace_na(list(label = "", adm3_name_label = "")) |> 
    st_as_sf() |> 
    ggplot() +
    geom_sf(aes(fill = value), linewidth = .1) +
    geom_sf(data = river, colour = "#90e0ef", fill = "#90e0ef", alpha = .4) +
    geom_sf_text(aes(label = paste0(adm3_name_label, "\n", label)), 
               size = 1.5, colour = "grey20") + 
    coord_sf(xlim = c(84.3, 85.8), ylim = c(27.63, 28.4), expand = TRUE) +
    scale_fill_viridis(direction = -1, begin = .3, labels = comma, 
                       na.value = "grey95") + 
    labs(title = paste0(str_to_title(str_replace_all(filter_value, "_", " "))), 
         fill = paste0(str_to_title(str_replace_all(filter_value, "_", "\n"))), 
         x = "", y = "")
}
```



```{r fig.height=9}
municipal_long |> 
  magnitude_plot("impacted_population") +

municipal_long |> 
  magnitude_plot("affected_buildings") + 
  
municipal_long |> 
  magnitude_plot("affected_hectares_agriculture") + 

  plot_layout(ncol = 1)
```

```{r}
municipal_long |> 
  filter(!str_detect(variable, "pc_") & variable != "impacted_households") |> 
  mutate(variable = str_replace_all(variable, "_", " "), 
         variable = str_to_title(variable)) |> 
  mutate(variable = fct_relevel(variable, 
  left_join(
    adm3, 
    by = c("adm2_pcode", "adm3_pcode")
  ) |> 
  st_as_sf() |> 
  ggplot() + 
  geom_sf(aes(fill = value), linewidth = .1) + 
  geom_sf_text(aes(label = paste0(adm3_name, "\n", round(value, 1))), 
               size = 1.5) +
  facet_wrap(~variable, ncol = 1) + 
  scale_fill_viridis(direction = -1, begin = .2)
  
```


```{r}
affected_municipalities_wards |> 
  left_join(
    wards, 
    by = c("adm3_pcode", "ward" = "NEW_WARD_N")
  ) |> 
  st_as_sf() |> 
  ggplot() +
  geom_sf() + 
  geom_sf(data = adm3 |> filter(adm3_pcode %in% affected_municipalities_wards$adm3_pcode), 
          alpha = .1) +
  geom_sf_text(data = adm3 |> filter(adm3_pcode %in% affected_municipalities_wards$adm3_pcode),
               aes(label = adm3_name), 
               size = 2, 
               colour = "red") + 
  geom_sf(data = river, colour = "blue", fill = "blue", alpha = .3)
```
